helix.org.meta.return: Not among Helix's code actions: it puts the cursor on the new heading, and a code action's edit cannot move the cursor (docs/keys/helix.org).
helix.org.meta.up: Helix's code action moves the subtree and leaves the cursor where it was in the text; Emacs's cursor goes with the subtree, as it does when the command moves it (window/showDocument).
helix.org.meta.down: Helix's code action moves the subtree and leaves the cursor where it was in the text; Emacs's cursor goes with the subtree, as it does when the command moves it (window/showDocument).
helix.org.tags.set: Not among Helix's code actions: it asks for the tags as text, which Helix cannot ask for on a server's behalf; from the command line, a rename at the cursor answers.
helix.org.property.set: Not among Helix's code actions: it asks for the property and its value as text, which Helix cannot ask for on a server's behalf; from the command line, a rename at the cursor answers.
helix.org.refile: Not among Helix's code actions: it asks for the target from a list (window/showMessageRequest), which Helix cannot show.
